description: Token safety for any Base token: real DEX liquidity summed over pairs, pair count, 24h volume, largest single-pair liquidity share, explicit flags (no pair / thin book / zero volume) and a verdict from fixed thresholds. Built because a money-routing agent that skips this step is one rug away from a bad week. Free verdict at /x402/token-safety/preview.
name: akari_token_safety
